#### Bitmap Protocol
- Each station declares via one bit whether it has data to send.
- Data is transmitted in order according to the station sequence.
- Efficiency: ⟦MC_4eba667f65919c1a_0⟧, where ⟦MC_3c5acfef7c6afbed_0⟧ is the frame length and ⟦MC_f0e081a6929dfd95_0⟧ is the number of stations.
